function.name: cancel_existing_appointment
function.description: Cancels an existing appointment after verifying the patient's identity.

phone.description: The patient's phone number for verification.
phone.title: Phone

dob.description: The patient's date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format for verification.
dob.title: Dob

appointment_date.description: The date of the appointment they wish to cancel, in YYYY-MM-DD format.
appointment_date.title: Appointment Date

reason.description: The reason for cancelling the appointment.
reason.title: Reason
